narration: You ease between two tar-slick pilings, the mud sucking at your boots. Through a gap in the planking above you can hear them — two voices, low and quick, and the unmistakable wet slap of someone hefting something heavy and wrapped in oilcloth. The size of a ledger. One more step and the rotten board under your foot begins, very slowly, to give.
dmNotes: I do not roll for the player. Requesting an open Stealth (DEX) check; the result rides the next turn's rolls. DC kept hidden.
